cues.text: A 1 MW IT load loses utility power. How long can 100 kWh bridge the outage?
Predict 300 seconds FROM the outage. Charging is disabled and the generator is failed.
Run: 100 × 0.90 × 0.95 = 85.5 kWh delivered to IT. At 1 MW, this lasts 307.8 seconds.
Outage begins at 300 s; the battery empties at 607.8 s. Utility returns at 900 s.
Export the complete JSON: exact inputs, input hash, events and interval energy ledger.
Optional Python verification downloads the reference runtime only when selected.
Exact match: all inputs, hashes and calculated values agree with the reference Python engine.
